figures.alt: A girl pushes a red wagon away from her while a boy pulls a blue wagon toward himself on a sunny playground.
figures.caption: A girl pushes a wagon away from her. A boy pulls a wagon toward him.

figures.alt: A cardboard ramp on a tile floor with a small red toy car at the bottom and a soft blue foam block at the end of the ramp, with tape marking the finish line and a paper cup nearby.
figures.caption: A finished test: a cardboard ramp, a toy car, and a foam stopper at the finish line. Your test can look a little different.

figures.alt: Interactive: choose a soft, medium or hard push and whether a wall is in the way, then push a toy car along floor tiles and see how far it goes.
figures.caption: Push a toy car softly or hard and see how far it goes.

figures.alt: Bar graph, How far the car rolled. The number line starts at 0 on the right. Soft push 2 floor tiles, about 60 centimeters. Strong push 6 floor tiles, about 180 centimeters.
figures.caption: A soft push sent the car 2 floor tiles (about 60 centimeters, or 2 feet). A strong push sent it 6 tiles (about 180 centimeters, or 6 feet). Zero is on the right.

figures.alt: Bar graph, Times the car was stopped (3 tries). Foam stopper 3 times out of 3 tries, Cardboard stopper 1 time out of 3 tries.
figures.caption: The foam stopper stopped the car 3 times out of 3. The cardboard stopper stopped it 1 time out of 3.
